title: Virtual Compute: evt return
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment. The bank return must identify the exact posted payment. Restore the returned principal as a positive amount, up to the original payment amount not already returned. Copy its method, customer, billing entity and currency. A partial return uses the distinct bank notice external reference. A duplicate bank notice produces no new write. Any failed payment fee is a separately identifiable return-fee charge under the lifecycle fee basis, never hidden in returned principal; a waived fee produces no fee posting.

## Evidence — bank return

For payment return, The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, original source reference, status, external reference. Those records correlate to the current action by evidence event reference, original source reference.
